    • raw

      @NotNull public @NotNull ScenarioProfile.Builder raw(@NotNull @NotNull String path, @Nullable @Nullable Object value)
      One override at an explicit configuration path.

      The escape hatch for anything the typed methods do not cover, and the natural way to copy a profile out of an addon's own YAML file. A null value removes the override.
